components.name: Functions
components.introduction: Scoped Solution requests and navigation capabilities.
components.guidance: Requests and scoped navigation target the current Solution. External HTTP(S) navigation requires user activation. Server routes own authorization and business rules.

members.name: navigate(path)
members.description: Navigates within the current Solution using a scoped path, or opens an HTTP(S) URL in a new tab. External URLs require user activation and open without an opener or referrer.

members.name: request(path, options)
members.description: Requests a Solution operation and returns its data. Options support the HTTP method, JSON, form data, and binary responses. Requests and responses are limited to 2,000,000 bytes, with at most 32 form entries and 8 pending operations. Successful writes automatically refresh cached View data. Failed HTTP requests reject with an Error containing an optional numeric status and a bounded client-facing message.

components.name: Hooks
components.introduction: React hooks for local state, synchronization, and loading Solution data.
components.guidance: Use controlled state for local interaction. Effects should synchronize with external systems, not duplicate derived state.

members.name: useState(initial)
members.description: Returns the current state and a setter. Pass a value or an initializer function; updates can use the previous state.

members.name: useEffect(effect, dependencies)
members.description: Synchronizes with external systems after rendering. Return a cleanup function to release timers or subscriptions. Include every reactive value used by the effect in its dependencies.

members.name: useMemo(factory, dependencies)
members.description: Caches a calculated value until its dependencies change. Use it for expensive calculations, not required application state.

members.name: useRef(initial)
members.description: Returns a stable object with a mutable current property. Changing current does not trigger a render.

members.name: useApi(path)
members.description: Returns Solution data and an awaitable invalidator scoped to the full request path. The renderer handles initial loading, errors, and retry.

components.name: Table
components.introduction: Displays data-driven rows without plugins or a second children-based table contract.
components.guidance: Present dense records as rows. Keep selection and query state explicit; do not wrap each row in a Card.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Data objects displayed as rows.

properties.name: hasHover
properties.description: Applies a hover highlight background to rows on pointer devices.

properties.name: isStriped
properties.description: Applies a background wash to even-numbered rows.

properties.name: columns
properties.type: { key: string; header?: ReactNode; width?: ColumnWidth; align?: "start" | "center" | "end"; renderCell?: ((row: T) => ReactNode); }[]
properties.description: Columns with custom cells and proportional() or pixel() widths.

components.name: Tabs
components.introduction: Switches between related content panels.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Tab elements defining labels and panel content.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Receives the selected Tab value; use with value to control selection.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected Tab value; omit for internal selection, initially choosing the first tab.

properties.name: Tab.children
properties.description: Panel content mounted only while this tab is selected.

properties.name: Tab.value
properties.description: Unique value identifying this tab.

properties.name: Tab.label
properties.description: Visible tab label and accessible panel name.

properties.name: Tab.isDisabled
properties.description: Whether the tab is disabled.

components.name: Text

properties.name: children
properties.description: Text content.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Text color; defaults to secondary for supporting text and primary otherwise.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Theme text style, or inherit to match surrounding text.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Font size override for the selected text style.

properties.name: weight

properties.name: display

properties.name: as

properties.name: maxLines

properties.name: hasTruncateTooltip

properties.name: wordBreak
properties.description: Word breaking for truncated text.

properties.name: textWrap

properties.name: justify

properties.name: hasCapsize

properties.name: hasStrikethrough

properties.name: hasTabularNumbers

groups.Runtime: Local state, Solution data, requests, and scoped navigation.
groups.Action: Operations and navigation through buttons, links, and action menus.
groups.Display: Records, text, metadata, status, progress, and file previews.
groups.Form: Collecting and submitting input through forms and field components.
groups.Layouts: Arranging content, panels, navigation, dialogs, tabs, and steps.

patterns.name: Data table
patterns.description: Present searchable records using data-driven rows and explicit query state.
steps: Load records with the documented Hooks API and keep search/filter state local.
Define Table columns and row actions using supported props; apply filtering or pagination on the server when needed.
Show an EmptyState when there are no matching records.

patterns.name: Editing form
patterns.description: Collect intent through named fields and persist changes through a validated Solution route.
steps: Inspect Form's submission contract and initialize fields from the record being edited.
Choose field components that match the server schema and use documented names and value contracts.
Submit to a Solution route that validates input and enforces authorization; display its documented success or error state.

patterns.name: Approval queue
patterns.description: Show pending work and make the next authorized action clear.
steps: Load pending records with the documented Hooks API and display their states as Table rows with Badge values.
Add explicit approve/reject actions through Button callbacks and scoped requests.
Enforce transitions and permissions on the Solution server, then refresh the queue after a successful action.
